issues.issue: Whether the underlying judicial reviews of the November and December detention decisions are moot
issues.applicant_position: Live evidentiary issue remains on the November decision; the December decision is not moot either.
issues.respondent_position: Matters are or will shortly be moot under Borowski because of the 30-day detention review scheme.

issues.issue: Whether the Applicant may bypass the Detention Review Protocol and the Rules by seeking the underlying relief on an urgent motion
issues.applicant_position: Following the normal process would not allow timely argument of the merits, so an urgent motion was needed.
issues.respondent_position: Applicant failed to follow the Detention Review Protocol and Rules, prejudicing the Respondent; the motion is a collateral attack.
issues.result_quote: It is clear the Court cannot countenance such a collateral attack of the ID decisions.
